critical_issues: Possible highlight/exposure artifact: a thin bright/clipped strip near the top edge suggests clipping or mis-aimed light/background.
warnings: Lighting/exposure: increase overall exposure substantially (several stops). If using World for the white sweep, raise World/background strength (Script line 74: try 1.25 -> 5–15) and ensure the background material is actually white.
Add/adjust studio lights: use a large soft key (Area) + fill + optional rim so the mug silhouette reads against the background; increase light size for softer shadows.
Camera/framing: verify the camera is aimed at the mug and countertop and that nothing is blocking the view; re-frame so the mug occupies a meaningful portion of the image.
Scene setup: ensure the mug and countertop geometry are present, enabled for render, not inside/behind a black occluder plane, and normals are correct.
Tone mapping/clipping: reduce any over-bright source causing the top clipped band, enable highlight roll-off/clamping as needed, and re-check with AgX (Script line 58) once exposure is in range.
